menus.label: Published relocated restaurant dishes
menus.note: PIF operator opening release names shoyu and shio ramen and dinner course, without dish prices. Checked own linked Instagram, landlord gallery, operator images and actual TableCheck page. TableCheck publishes booking charges and rules, not ramen/course prices; old June anniversary-event miso ramen is expired. FamilyMart collaboration products priced ¥298/¥159/¥698 are supermarket retail goods, not this restaurant menu. Prior-address prices and awards are not transferred. Linked TableCheck is a ramen booking page; confirm the distinct night membership/course booking route. Booking: ¥500 per person non-refundable reservation fee, up to five diners, one noodle dish per person; no strollers, children must eat the children’s ramen (under ten, not for adults), slots released two weeks ahead, gathering time may precede entry by 5–25 minutes. No strong fragrance; allergy requests through form are not accommodated, tell staff on arrival. Header says ¥2,000 per-person cancellation within 24 hours; final mandatory consent says any confirmed cancellation incurs ¥2,000 plus booking fee, so resolve the broader policy before confirming. Date/party changes require cancellation and rebooking. No reservations by email.
